change_summary: Treat a request to transform selected material for a stated continuing workflow as future-use authorization before ordinary-deliverable handling, preserving exact sources and reconciling their Work Model without a duplicate save question.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill makes the future-use purpose govern the whole transformation request, preventing a chat-only rewrite plus duplicate save question while preserving the one-off no-write boundary.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-15.6 orders future-work transformation intent before ordinary-deliverable handling while preserving Agent-owned Work Model planning and typed Runtime receipts.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.46 without changing transport, trust, consent, or compatibility-family boundaries.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.32; registry-backed update checks return an exact install command plus post-install verification, and Workspace capabilities expose server-owned limits.

help_center.note: Public guidance contrasts future-use transformation with an ordinary one-off deliverable and keeps attachment presence alone as no-write.

package_setup.note: Setup and SessionStart classify future-use transformation before any write/no-write promise without turning arbitrary attachments into write consent.

harness_and_mainline.note: The owner history records the live chat-only rewrite miss and the restartable Harness keeps fresh effect proof explicit rather than replaying writes or adding Runtime semantic enforcement.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.46 publication and hashes can be verified here; Claude directory acceptance and fresh secondary-host behavior remain external receipts.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover future-use transformation precedence, adapter convergence, ordinary one-off and attachment-only countercases, explicit oracle-incomplete replay, package export, and localized Help; J5T1 fresh rerun is the live behavior gate.
